entry.title: A32X Tools · A320 ECAM Resets
entry.content:

全部价格信息

应用描述

Aviation Maintenance Tools is a professional maintenance reference app for aircraft technicians, focused on A320 troubleshooting and ECAM reset procedures. It provides fast, structured access to key information used during fault troubleshooting, reset procedures, structural damage report creation, and everyday maintenance tasks—helping technicians work more efficiently on the line or in base maintenance. ECAM Fault Messages • Extensive database of fault messages with the associated circuit breakers (CBs) required for each A320 ECAM reset • Images of aircraft panels showing where to find each circuit breaker • Clear, step-by-step ECAM reset procedures with an integrated countdown • Maintenance manual and MEL references linked to each message Quick Fault Search • Instantly find messages using a fast search engine, reducing time-consuming searches during line maintenance calls • Browse messages organized by ATA chapter • Recent tab for quick access to previously viewed content Avionics Tour • Interactive photo tour of the A320neo avionics compartment • Navigate through AFT, FWD, LH MID and RH MID bays with real aircraft photos • Tap any LRU marker to view its name, location and technical description • Built-in search to quickly find any unit across the compartment Structural Damage Reports • Interactive structural damage report forms generator with support for multiple damage entries, eliminating paper notes and improving handover • Useful for reporting a single damage or multiple damages (e.g., after lightning events) • Attach damage photos taken with the device camera • Export reports to PDF or ZIP files (including images) to continue working on a computer or another phone with the app Alpha Callups • Complete list of Alpha Callups, filtered by engine model • Built-in search engine for quick searches Electrical Contacts • Electrical contacts, terminals, and splices part numbers library, with quick search function • Direct reference to the ESPM figure where each item is located • Crimping and insertion/extraction references included Common Part Numbers • Commonly used aircraft part numbers organized by category and aircraft zone • Each part number can include a description and photos • Add your own part numbers with photos taken using the device camera • Create and share your custom part-number list with colleagues • Useful for quickly finding references during line maintenance Maintenance Manual References • Structured breakdown of the maintenance manual index • Fast search for quick lookup Disclaimer – Training & Reference Use Only This app is designed for training, reference, and informational purposes only. This app does not replace official documentation. Fault messages, reset procedures, structural damage reports, manual/MEL/ESPM references, electrical contact data, and part number information are provided as a learning aid for maintenance technicians. Users must always consult the latest official manuals and procedures before performing any maintenance or operational task on an aircraft. This app must not be used as the sole source for maintenance decisions. This app is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or an official product of any aircraft manufacturer. The app does not copy, reproduce, or distribute proprietary manufacturer materials (including manual pages or documentation) and does not use manufacturer logos or branding.

把事情做好！获奖肯定的 Things 应用帮助您规划一天行程、管理项目，并帮助您按部就班地朝目标迈进。 除了强大的功能外，最厉害的是，使用起来非常简单方便。在短时间内理清琐事，无论是基本任务还是伟大的人生目标都顿时变得井然有序，然后开始专注在今天最重要的事情上。 “在所有我们测试过的应用中，Things 在设计与功能结合方面表现最优，除了几乎具备所有其他用户应用程式的强大功能外，还有着永远不会干扰您工作的愉悦界面。” —Wirecutter, 纽约时报 主要功能 • 您的待办事项 以强大的“待办事项”为基本组成部分 — 每一则待办事项都是迈向大成就的一小步。您可以为其添加备注、加上标签、安排时程，或者再将其细分成更小的步骤。 • 您的项目 为任何重大目标建立项目，再添加待办事项以完成目标。在进行规划时，使用标题让列表更井井有条。还有一个地方可以写下备注，并且可以订定截止日期以掌控进度。 • 您的区域 将人生的各个不同部分设为“区域”，例如工作、家庭、理财等。这让一切井井有条，并让您在处理细节时仍能看清全局。 • 您的计划 您的日程安排的所有内容都整齐地排列在“今天”和“计划”列表中，显示待办事项和日历事件。每天早上，查看今天计划并决定想做什么。 更多您会喜爱的内容 进一步熟悉后，您会发现 Things 还有许多其他有用的功能。仅在此举些例子： • 提醒事项 — 设置时间后 Things 便会自动提醒您。 • 重复 — 自动依据您设置的时间表重复待办事项。 • 今晚 — 特别让您安排今晚计划。 • 日历集成 — 同时查看事件和待办事项。 • 标签 — 将待办事项分类并快速筛选列表。 • 快速输入 — 只要一想到一件事便可以随时从任何地方建立待办事项。 • 快速查找 — 立即找到待办事项、标题或标签。 • 输入任意门 — 利用键盘从一个列表跳到另一个列表，只需开始键入！ • 小组件 — 在桌面或“通知中心”中查看您的列表。 • 邮寄至 Things — 将电子邮件转发至 Things，变成待办事项。 • 标记 — 设置备注结构和样式。 为 MAC 设计 Things 专为 Mac 量身订制并有深度系统集成。从其他 App 快速创建待办事项、连接您的日历、添加各种小组件、从提醒事项导入 — Things 无所不能！还可以集成快捷指令，实现自动化工作流。 获奖设计 Things 因其出色的设计而获得许多赞誉，包括两次获得苹果设计奖。每个细节都经过深思熟虑，并力求完善。 “简直是生产力工具界的独角兽：足够深入以完成严肃的工作，又不可思议地易于使用，精美的设计令人光是看着也着迷。” —Apple 现在就用 THINGS 无论您想在生活中完成什么，Things 都能帮助您达成目标。现在就安装应用，看看您能做些什么！ • Things 还提供 iPad、iPhone、Apple Watch 和 Apple Vision Pro 版本（单独出售）。 • 通过 Things Cloud 服务免费同步。 • 提供 Mac 免费试用版：www.things.app 若有任何问题，敬请与我们联系。我们将很乐意提供帮助。
